OpenData-Benchmark-ITA
	


	
		
		Overview
	

OpenData-Benchmark-ITA is a multiple-choice benchmark dataset designed to evaluate the capability of Large Language Models (LLMs) to understand, retrieve, and reason over public Open Data published by European government portals.
The current release focuses exclusively on Italian Open Data and is based on datasets published on the official Italian government portal, data.gov.it. Future releases will extend the benchmark to include… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/VillanovaAI/OpenData-Benchmark-ITA.
reputation: A focused benchmark from VillanovaAI for evaluating LLMs on Italian public Open Data; modest adoption within niche groups working on government-data QA and retrieval.
